title: Code of Conduct Acknowledgement
scope: Applies to Business Analysts during their first 30 days.
summary: Requires new hires to read and acknowledge the code of conduct.
details: Conflicts of interest must be disclosed.
Retaliation for good-faith reporting is prohibited.
Use approved ethics and HR reporting channels.
escalation: Raise a Workplace Concern ticket for suspected misconduct.
exceptions: Any exception requires documented approval from the policy owner.
